subject: Suncore vendor onboarding - PO evidence & VAT clarifications
messages:
From: Emily Chen <emily.chen@suncore.com>
To: olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajiv Patel <rajiv.p@suncore.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor setup: Redwood - PO requirements and AP packet

Hi Olga,

Quick intro — I'm Emily on Suncore's AP team. We're ready to add Redwood Inference as an approved vendor so payments can flow against upcoming POs for the pilot deployment. Before I submit the enrollment to our vendor portal, can you confirm the minimal evidence we need? Specifically:

- Legal business name + remit address (we have: Redwood Inference, 425 Market St, SF)
- EIN or VAT id for US/EU billing
- W9 or W-8 (if applicable)
- A PDF sample invoice with PO reference and remit info
- Bank/ACH details or instructions (we use tokenized EFT)

Also flagging two items: Suncore needs one invoice per PO line (we occasionally allocate to multiple cost centers) and we support early-pay programs but need the invoice to contain a net-30 baseline and a PO number in the invoice header.

Can you send the AP packet and a test invoice we can use to validate ingestion? We need to onboard by EOD Friday if possible.

Thanks,
Emily Chen
Sr. AP Analyst, Suncore Payments

--
Attachment: none (will accept PDF upload to portal)

From: olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Emily Chen <emily.chen@suncore.com>
Cc: Rajiv Patel <rajiv.p@suncore.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, logan_wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor setup: Redwood - PO requirements and AP packet

Hi Emily — thanks for the clear list. Attached is our AP onboarding packet and a sample invoice formatted to Suncore's requirements. Summary below and next steps: 

Attachments sent:
- Suncore_AP_Onboarding_Packet.pdf (contains legal entity, remit address, billing contacts, standard payment terms, and vendor contact matrix)
- W9_RedwoodInfr.pdf (EIN evidence for US entities)
- sample_invoice_001.xml (machine-readable invoice)

What to expect in the packet:
- We include both the legal operating entity (Redwood Inference, Inc.) and the billing entity used for hosted contracts. If you need a specific legal name on the invoice for tax reasons, please tell us which legal entity to use and we'll reissue.
- Banking: we provide tokenized ACH instructions in the packet. For security we don't send raw account numbers over email.
- PO placement: sample_invoice_001.xml shows PO in the "Invoice/POReference" field and a single-line mapping for the pilot PO. If you route to multiple cost centers, we can emit separate invoice lines per PO line on request.

Questions for you before we finalize:
1) Is Suncore requesting VAT evidence for the US entity or do you need our EU VAT registration too (we have a Luxembourg sub for EU billing)?
2) Do you require a signed vendor agreement uploaded to your portal, or will the onboarding packet suffice for payment activation?

We've pre-created a vendor record in your portal using the email emily.chen@suncore.com. If you prefer, Marissa (cc'd) can do a quick DocuSign for a master services addendum.

I'll ping Logan to coordinate the sample invoice test and confirm expected payment rails.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Vendor Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

--
Attachments: Suncore_AP_Onboarding_Packet.pdf; W9_RedwoodInfr.pdf; sample_invoice_001.xml

From: Rajiv Patel <rajiv.p@suncore.com>
To: olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, emily.chen <emily.chen@suncore.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor setup: Redwood - PO requirements and AP packet

Thanks Olga — packet received and uploaded to our vendor portal (ticket #VN-8129). Couple of clarifications from tax: 

- Suncore will be paying an EU-based PO for some of the pilot analytics work. Do you have an EU VAT number (for reverse-charge) or will Redwood invoice from the US entity and we handle VAT on our side? If you invoice from the EU entity please attach the VAT_Certificate_Suncore.pdf for verification.
- For early-pay enrollment: our program requires the invoice to include the gross amount, payment term, and an explicit early-pay discount clause (we can send the template).

Also, our portal rejected the sample_invoice_001.xml on one field — it expects POReference to be exactly 10 characters. Can you resubmit an XML with PO padded or supply a PDF version (the portal accepts both)?

If we can get the updated invoice and the VAT doc by EOD Thursday we can approve the vendor and kick off the PO.

Cheers,
Rajiv Patel
AP Team Lead — Suncore Payments

--
Internal note: ticket VN-8129 created by Emily; assigned to AP ingestion team.

From: olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Rajiv Patel <rajiv.p@suncore.com>, Emily Chen <emily.chen@suncore.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, logan_wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor setup: Redwood - PO requirements and AP packet

Hi Rajiv / Emily — appreciate the quick validation. Actions we've taken: 

1) Uploaded VAT_Certificate_Suncore.pdf to the shared Drive link and attached a vendor-stamped VAT file that meets Suncore's portal schema. (See Drive link in related_links)
2) Re-generated the sample invoice as sample_invoice_001_pdf.pdf and re-exported sample_invoice_001.xml with POReference padded to 10 characters (PO0004546). Both are attached to this thread and uploaded to your portal under ticket VN-8129.
3) W9 is included for US payments; if you want invoices from the Luxembourg legal entity we can issue an EU invoice and include our EU VAT id — let me know which path you prefer for the pilot.
4) For early-pay enrollment: Marissa will coordinate DocuSign of the early-pay opt-in clause. Marissa — can you please send the DocuSign template and confirm the discount language (we typically accept up to a 2% discount for net-30 converted to early-pay).

If everything looks good on your side we ask for a short test payment (small-dollar invoice) against PO0004546 so we can verify remittance and reference mapping. Once the test clears we'll mark the vendor as fully active.

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Vendor Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

--
Attachments: VAT_Certificate_Suncore.pdf; sample_invoice_001_pdf.pdf; sample_invoice_001.xml; W9_RedwoodInfr.pdf
